title: Qwen3.8-27B on DGX Spark — ggerganov's llama.cpp MTP recipe in the official container
slug_note: Q4_K_M main + Q4_0 MTP draft straight from ggml-org, run in ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:full-cuda: 18.08 tok/s decode over a 22k-token generation, 488 tok/s prefill.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M main (18.97GB) + mtp-Q4_0 draft (1.68GB) from the same ggml-org repo
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of ggml-org/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-26 test

engine.config: Official full-cuda container on the Spark; HF-repo pull flags, MTP draft enabled by default, reasoning preserved.

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): 42.3 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Spark 128GB unified; ~19GB Q4_K_M + 1.7GB MTP draft + KV — 32GB is a generous floor. Runs inside the full-cuda container.

caveats: 18.08 tok/s is the mean over a 22,373-token generation; the 3-second window rate ranged 14.02-21.77 tok/s.
A 'small increase' over the thread OP's unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL config on the same box (~15 -> 18.08 tok/s).
ggerganov posted the identical command line on X (https://x.com/ggerganov/status/2088340681701925253) — cited as corroboration; rot-prone.
Full command lines and raw server logs are in the discussion thread.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): `llama-server -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M -hfd ggml-org/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:Q4_0 --spec-default --spec-type draft-mtp --reasoning-preserve` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 3820 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 42.3 GiB (weights + KV at llama.cpp's default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens on this build)).
